$comment: App-store-style privacy manifest for the OASIS Agent Command Center. Generated from the product's real behaviour on 2026-07-27 and kept in sync with lib/legal/constants.ts (DATA_MATRIX + SUBPROCESSORS), which is what /privacy renders. If you change either, change both in the same commit.
verificationMethod: Static scan of app/ and lib/ for collected form fields, outbound provider hosts, storage buckets, and analytics SDKs.

tracking.note: No Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, PostHog, Mixpanel, or @vercel/analytics is present in this application as of the lastVerified date. Cookies are limited to authentication and session state.

sharedWith: Anthropic (when present in an uploaded document)
dataCollected.retention: Duration of the active application; deleted on request
dataCollected.regulatoryNote: Sensitive personal information under Quebec Law 25 and the CPRA. Collection requires express consent and, under Law 25 s.3.3, a privacy impact assessment before use in an automated process.

dataCollected.retention: Stored with the application; deleted on request

subprocessors.name: Anthropic PBC
subprocessors.role: LLM inference (Claude); chat, agent tasks, and document field extraction
subprocessors.openIssue: Document extraction runs via the Claude CLI on an individual subscription, not a commercial API account. Consumer subscription terms differ materially from Anthropic's Commercial Terms and DPA. Sensitive identifiers (SSN, DOB, EIN) traverse this path.

subprocessors.name: OpenAI, L.L.C.
subprocessors.role: LLM inference (GPT) for delegated code and review tasks

userRights.optOutOfSale: Not applicable — no sale or sharing as defined by the CPRA

openGaps: No signed DPA covering the LLM providers for the document-extraction path.
Law 25 privacy impact assessment not yet completed for cross-border transfer of sensitive identifiers.
No French-language version of the privacy policy or terms (Charter of the French Language, art. 55, for consumer contracts of adhesion in Quebec).
DMCA Designated Agent not yet registered with the U.S. Copyright Office.
Legal copy has not been reviewed by counsel.
